name: Structural First Natural Frequency
description: First natural frequency of the satellite structure. Checks whether it is high enough to avoid resonance with the launch vehicle.

elements.name: First Axial Natural Frequency
elements.description: Lowest axial eigenfrequency of the satellite in launch configuration. Uncertain due to joint stiffness and mass tolerance.

uncertainty.source: FEM modal analysis with structural parameter variation

elements.name: Minimum Required Natural Frequency
elements.description: Ariane 6 user manual minimum payload frequency requirement

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(f_1) = f_1 if f_1 >= f_min, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The Ariane 6 minimum frequency requirement guards the structural natural frequency uncertainty set; frequencies below 30 Hz risk launch vehicle coupling.
